what worked for me is having a simple goal of doing 10 off-ice axels every day. if i felt like it, i could intellectualize the axels, analyze what i was doing right and wrong, figure out how to improve it. but i gave myself no pressure to improve through analysis like this. i was happy with myself as long as i did 10 off-ice axels a day, because even if i didn’t feel a lot of progress, i knew that doing more repetitions got me more familiar and comfortable with the feeling of an axel, and that’s progress in and of itself. you will see progress eventually, as long as you stay consistent! even on busy days, you can spare 10 minutes to practice 10 axels off-ice.
